name: Radicale
description: A small CalDAV and CardDAV server for your calendars and contacts

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Your calendars and address books (collections), plus the users file with the login. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Radicale web page and CalDAV/CardDAV server, published on host as 6886

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: RADICALE_USER
variables.description: The user name for the Radicale login.

variables.name: RADICALE_PASSWORD
variables.description: Leave blank and IceStore makes a password on first start and shows it in the app's log under CREDENTIALS. Type one here to use your own.
